name: Quantic at Pérola Negra
description: Dance the night away to the eclectic, globetrotting beats of renowned British musician and DJ, Quantic.
longDescription:
On April 24, 2026, British musician and DJ Quantic, also known as Will Holland, will perform at Pérola Negra Club. Quantic is known for his diverse musical output, which spans electronic, funk, soul, and Latin American genres, often incorporating live instrumentation and global influences into his productions and DJ sets. His career includes numerous albums and collaborations, establishing him as a figure in contemporary global music.

Attendees can expect an evening of dance music within the setting of Pérola Negra Club. The atmosphere will be focused on the musical performance, drawing an audience interested in electronic and world music. The event is scheduled for a Friday night, indicating a typical club night duration.

Tickets for Quantic at Pérola Negra Club are priced variably. Pérola Negra Club is located in central Porto, accessible via public transport. It is within walking distance of several metro stations, including Bolhão and Trindade, and is served by various bus routes.
